facts.value: Provides the common FallAerial motion state's collision callback. It forwards the fighter to ft_800831CC with terrain predicate ftCo_80096CC8 and contact response ft_80082B1C; accepted shared contact invokes that response, otherwise wall-jump checking precedes ledge-grab checking. Its placement in ftswing.c does not make it a held-item swing-specific falling phase.
facts.rationale: Corrects subsystem attribution using the active motion-table consumer and exact canonical callees.

facts.value: Implements environmental collision processing for the common FallAerial state, not an inferred held-item swing aftermath. The supplied predicate rejects line -1, accepts other solid lines, and requires stick Y strictly above the common threshold for platforms; the shared dispatcher may invoke the velocity-dependent contact response or attempt wall jumping and ledge grabbing.
facts.rationale: Active registration outranks source-file proximity; predicate and dispatcher establish the actual interaction.

facts.value: int item-kind identifier; the observed caller passes itGetKind(fp->item_gobj). Accepted values are 12, 11, 13, 24, 22 and 23; all others report and assert.
facts.rationale: Definition and caller directly establish semantic input domain.

facts.value: Fighter_GObj* borrowed fighter object; its Fighter data supplies held-item identity, fighter kind and shared setup context. No null-object guard is provided locally.
facts.rationale: Concrete signature and all accesses are explicit; no local ownership transfer occurs.

facts.value: enum_t attack-form selector with valid semantic domain 0–4: 0 from Attack1, 1 from AttackS3, 2 from AttackS4, 4 from AttackDash, and 3 from the shared swing held-A continuation path. The dispatcher does not range-check it; selector 3 requires FTKIND_CAPTAIN and bypasses only the integer motion table.
facts.rationale: Cross-file callers prove selector meanings; local indexing establishes the unchecked boundary.

facts.value: Fighter_GObj* borrowed active fighter object, forwarded unchanged to ft_800831CC with two globally defined callback functions. The wrapper neither stores the object nor transfers ownership.
facts.rationale: The complete wrapper contains only the delegation call.
